title: Statistical versus machine learning-based spatial interpolation of post-processed ensemble weather forecasts
abstract: arXiv:2609.07512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Statistical post-processing improves ensemble weather forecasts, but generating calibrated predictions at locations without observations remains challenging. This study compares statistical and machine-learning-based methods for post-processing ECMWF 2-m temperature and 10-m wind speed forecasts at observed and unobserved stations in Germany. We consider EMOS-based approaches, distributional regression networks, Transformers, and graph neural networks under both limited and extended predictor settings. For temperature, we also investigate linear forecast combinations and propose an altitude-aware linear pool (ALP). The results show that post-processing improves upon the raw ensemble in most settings, but no single method performs best across all variables, station groups, and evaluation metrics. The proposed ALP provides a small but significant improvement over the standard linear pool at unobserved locations.

translated_title: 基于统计方法与机器学习方法的集合天气预报后处理空间插值比较
translated_abstract: 统计后处理能够改进集合天气预报，但在没有观测数据的地点生成校准预测仍然具有挑战性。本研究比较了统计方法和基于机器学习的方法，用于对德国境内有观测站点和无观测站点的ECMWF 2米温度和10米风速预报进行后处理。我们在有限预测因子和扩展预测因子两种设置下，考察了基于EMOS的方法、分布回归网络、Transformer以及图神经网络。对于温度，我们还研究了线性预报组合，并提出了一种海拔感知线性池化（ALP）方法。结果表明，在大多数设置下，后处理均优于原始集合预报，但没有单一方法能在所有变量、站点组和评估指标上都表现最佳。所提出的ALP方法在无观测地点相比标准线性池化带来了小幅但显著的改进。
tldr: 本研究比较了统计与机器学习方法对集合天气预报进行后处理及空间插值的效果，并提出了一种海拔感知线性池化（ALP）方法，在无观测地点的温度预报上相比标准线性池化取得了小幅但显著的改进。
en_tdlr: This study compares statistical and machine learning-based post-processing methods for spatial interpolation of ensemble weather forecasts, and proposes an altitude-aware linear pool (ALP) that yields a small but significant improvement over the standard linear pool at unobserved locations.
